simple.summary: חֲנָמָל (chănâmâl) means perhaps the aphis or plantlouse First listed occurrence: Ps 78 47.

definitions.full: H2602. chanamel [ חֲנָמֵל ] noun [masculine] only בַּחֲנָמַ֑ל Psa 78:47 (on form see Dr Sm p. 98 ) as instrument of destroying sycomores (|| בָּרָד ); meaning conjectural; ᵑ9 ᵐ5 frost .
